title: BST Validation
statement:
Propagate ancestor bounds to determine whether every key in a left subtree is strictly smaller and every key in a right subtree strictly larger.

Input
n, then n lines value left right for nodes 1 through n; child ID 0 denotes an absent child.

Output
Print YES or NO.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Values have absolute value at most 10⁹. The child links form one rooted tree with root 1.
